legal.draftNotice: Draft — under legal review. The final text will be published before launch.

termsPoints.p1: This is a community for amateur football. You must be 13 or older; players under 18 need a guardian's approval.
termsPoints.p2: Match recording is optional and has its own consent. Clips are shown according to privacy settings, and live streaming needs a separate consent.
termsPoints.p3: No abuse, fake accounts, or manipulation of ratings or votes. We may remove content and suspend accounts that break these rules.
termsPoints.p4: The app is free during the pilot. Bookings are paid at the pitch, stars are reward points with no cash value, and rankings are in beta and never for sale.
termsPoints.p5: These terms are governed by the laws of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.

privacyPoints.p1: We collect: email, name, date of birth, city and neighbourhood, position, photo (optional) and, when you agree, match videos and clips, check-ins and votes.
privacyPoints.p2: We use them to run bookings, recording, highlights and ratings, for safety, and to measure the pilot.
privacyPoints.p3: Players under 18: profiles are private by default, their guardian controls visibility and recording, and their clips are visible only to match participants and their guardians.
privacyPoints.p4: We never make your data public unless you (or your guardian) choose to. Service providers (hosting, email) process data on our behalf.
privacyPoints.p5: You can access, download, correct and delete your data under Jordan's Personal Data Protection Law. Full-match videos are deleted after 30 days.
